craft_notes: Sthāyin: Rati for sight and stay (abhilāṣa) settling into praise. Comma→colon after being (ache stated, question released); Vṛtti gloss kept, no smoothing. Rejected: resolving bhāvatka — left as T1/L0. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Blest One — be! — the ache to brood thy shadowy being:
keen to cut rebirth's scare — whom would it not please?
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhagavan bhava bhāvatkaṃ bhāvaṃ bhāvayituṃ ruciḥ punarbhavabhayocchedadakṣā kasmai na rocate
